title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
snippet: Media coverage and a live-blog summary of Fabio Giglietto's presentation at the 2026 International Communication Association (ICA) conference in Cape Town. The article summarizes Giglietto's research on how partisan alignment, journalistic quality (using NewsGuard ratings), and Facebook's shifting algorithmic governance have collectively shaped user engagement and amplification on the platform over a six-year period.
description: A blog post on snurb.info announcing the release of M/C Journal's special 'twitter' issue, highlighting Fabio Giglietto as co-author of an article analyzing the history of academic data access to Twitter/X.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: Press coverage detailing Giglietto's research paper, 'A Pretty Blunt Approach,' which analyzed 2.5 million social media posts and exposed how Meta's content reduction policies caused a 72% drop in visibility for Italian parliamentarians. The article highlights how this research spurred a formal inquiry in the European Parliament and was featured on the investigative TV program 'Report' on Rai3.
description: Press coverage detailing Fabio Giglietto's research paper 'A Pretty Blunt Approach' on how Meta's algorithms reduced visibility for Italian politicians, which sparked a European Parliament inquiry.
